title: Le Creuset Enameled Cast Iron Baking Dish – No. 28
description:
Beautiful Le Creuset enameled cast iron oven dish (No. 28), designed for cooking enthusiasts who appreciate quality and durability.
Made from high-quality cast iron, it ensures excellent and even heat distribution, allowing your dishes to cook perfectly every time. Ideal for roasting, baking, gratins, and slow-cooked meals.
The elegant and timeless design fits perfectly in any kitchen and adds a touch of sophistication to your table. The durable enamel coating also makes it easy to clean. Lovely color.
As with all my items, this is a vintage piece, which means it has its own charm, patina, and some signs of age that reflect its history.
Please check the photos carefully, as they show the actual condition and are an important part of the description.
